conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and author. Codex executed the clean-room automation on the founder's machine under explicit authorization. This is internal founder-led review, not external validation.

scientificReview.rationale: Approve the corrected M1 evidence only within the documented nine-scenario software corpus, six-scenario temporary Git corpus, syntactic observation boundary and explicit version-at-use condition. The Python 3.12.14 clean-room reproduction and measured baselines are finite internal evidence and do not establish superiority, external validation or safety.

milestoneClosure.rationale: Close M1 as an operational and scientifically bounded read-only analyzer with a conservative Git adapter. Closure does not authorize execution or merge and does not assert external validation, production safety, complete semantic dependency discovery, general confluence, contextual equivalence or a Yang-Baxter result. It is not a package release or repository-visibility decision.

limits: Synthetic bounded corpora do not establish production safety or general applicability.
